source.name: ESPN public NBA summary (unofficial)
source.game_identity: ESPN event ID; each game observation must match the independent ESPN scoreboard ID, teams, team IDs where available, and final score.
source.player_identity: ESPN athlete ID; name-only matching is never used for trends.
source.immutability: Each new game version is written once. A corrected summary creates a new content-versioned observation; previous files are never replaced.
